messages:
viv: heads-up: trying to cut a patch for samplekit but publish is blocked. regendiff flagged a bunch of generated test snippets added to demos/ which triggered our changelog heuristics.
ci-bot: publish job 3421 blocked: regendiff mismatch detected -> https://ci.redwood.example/3421
arjun: test snippets? those are generated by the new example-snippet feature in typegen. paste the diff?
viv: snippet: ```diff
+ docs/demos/snippets/auth-example.ts: added generated snippet for auth flow
+ tests/generated/snippets/auth-example.test.ts: added
```
tay: ah, our changelog-generator treats any new files under pkg/ or docs/ as a potential user-visible change and bumped minor. For SDKs we only want to bump if public API changed, not helper tests or embedded snippets.
jen: semver bot logic currently: file adds/deletes in tracked dirs -> candidate bump. We need to narrow the scope for SDK packages: only exported symbols / package.json exports should influence semver decisions.
arjun: quick unblock: add a .regendiffignore entry for tests/generated and docs/demos/snippets so CI treats these as ignored noise. Will open hotfix PR.
publish-bot: note: publishing paused pending CI checks and manual semver confirmation.
viv: confirmed local repro: `yarn typegen:regen --spec=samplekit && git status` shows the new snippet files. After adding .regendiffignore and committing, regendiff is clean.
typegen-bot: artifact uploaded for job 3421: https://artifacts.redwood/regendiff/3421.txt
jen: short-term ignore is fine, but let's be explicit: 1) update changelog-generator to compute a canonical API manifest (exported symbols + signatures) and diff that instead of file-level diffs; 2) add a default .regendiffignore for generated test/snippet paths; 3) surface regendiff artifact link in the PR template so reviewers can see what changed. Filing issues and a small epic.
tay: also noticed Windows devs see extra snippet header lines due to CRLF handling which caused more noise. I'll add a normalization step to strip trailing blank lines and normalize EOLs in snippets before writing.
arjun: PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/pulls/2433 - adds .regendiffignore, normalizes snippet output, and excludes snippet-only adds from semver heuristics. cc @jen @viv.
ci-bot: preview rerun for PR 2433: regendiff now ignores snippet files and publish gate cleared on preview.
viv: thanks. follow-up: let's also add an onboarding note in CONTRIBUTING.md: "If you add example snippets via typegen, run `yarn typegen:preview` and ensure the artifacts are in the intended demo path; avoid committing generated tests unless they are intended for the package."
jen: agreed. long-term: switch changelog-generator to API-manifest diffing and add a UI checkbox in publish flow to confirm non-API changes are intentionally published. This should reduce accidental semver noise hitting downstream SDK consumers.
viv: merging hotfix now to unblock QA. will track the epic and add a small entry to the release playbook. :shipit:
